title: Two meta-harness seats on two computers keep distinct record keys, and each measures its own computer's commit log

looked_in: contracts/seats.json: two harness seats, harness-office-20261016-1 (Office) and harness-scope-20261019-1 (microscope computer), both with paths contracts/harness/
the four harness schemas and check 89's ALLOWED_PATHS entry: every key is date-based with no seat in it
origin/main's history of contracts/harness/: no commit by the second seat yet

changes.change: The incident id pattern also accepts INC-<YYYYMMDD>-<machine>-<nn>, where <machine> is the seat's machine word from its name (office, scope, ...). Existing ids stay valid. Check 89's duplicate rule then cannot fire across seats, and the on-date rule reads the date the same way.

ALLOWED_PATHS also accepts retro/<YYYYMMDD>-<machine>(-<n>)?.json. Check 89 reads both forms. It may also check that a record's machine word matches the machine word of its recorded_by or seat, so a seat cannot write under the other's key.

Proposal numbers are a single sequence and stay so. A seat takes the next free HP number only from HEAD after a fetch. The duplicate is caught by the file path at merge, which is loud, so no schema change is proposed for proposals.

Each seat measures its own computer's .git/sma-seat-commit.jsonl, which the other cannot read, and says so in its retro. Shared counts, such as commits touching contracts/harness/, are taken from origin.

fixtures.path: a rejected group with two incident lines of one date from two machines under the old pattern, and an accepted control with the machine word

already_running: harness-scope-20261019-1, if its session has been seated; it has not committed yet
reach.how_they_learn: This seat writes to the second seat through the intake seats of both computers, because no session message crosses computers here. Until HP-013 lands, this seat keeps to retro/<date>.json and incident numbers 01 to 49, and asks the other to use 50 to 99 and retro/<date>-2.json, as an interim convention.
reach.use_site: check 89, at the commit of a colliding record

notes: A reshape: no rule changes, only the shape of the keys, so that two legitimate writers stop colliding. The interim convention in reach uses numbers only as a split, not as a threshold anything is compared against. The admitted paths widen no seat's write reach: both seats already own contracts/harness/.
